'''Koobis''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] criminal who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Koobis worked for a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] operation established by the [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and, at some point during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Koobis was present in [[Tolea Biqua]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]], with the Rodian [[Teeku]] and the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Nawara Blen]]. Using a modified [[transponder]], the trio summoned the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Starchaser IV]]'' to [[Docking Bay 27 (Genarius)|Docking Bay 27]] in Tolea Biqua, and requested that [[Heroes of Cularin|the ship's crew]] transport a crate of illicit goods to Jan.
